Senior Platform Engineer
Gridforge · Remote (EMEA) · Full-time

Gridforge runs the infrastructure behind real-time energy-trading platforms for utilities across Europe.

What you'll do
- Own our Kubernetes platform across three cloud regions.
- Write Go services and Terraform modules used by every product team.
- Lead incident response and improve reliability.

Requirements
- 6+ years of experience in infrastructure or platform engineering.
- Strong Go.
- Running Kubernetes in production at scale.
- Terraform.
- Deep AWS or GCP experience.
- Strong Linux internals and networking knowledge.

Nice to have
- Python.
- Prometheus and Grafana.
